title: Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia: 21-Hydroxylase Deficiency, 17-OHP and Crisis Care
subject: ss-paediatric-endocrinology
module: Adrenal Cortex, CAH and Differences of Sex Development

steps.say: Monogenic enzyme blocks in adrenal steroidogenesis redirect precursors into virulent androgen excess.
steps.tx: Evaluate adrenal enzymatic pathways by recognizing **21-hydroxylase deficiency dominance** as the major cause of CAH. Deficiency of 21-hydroxylase (CYP21A2 gene on chromosome 6p21.3) accounts for > 90-95% of congenital adrenal hyperplasia, resulting in impaired cortisol and aldosterone synthesis with precursor shunting into androgens.

steps.say: The degree of residual enzymatic activity determines whether neonates waste salt or manifest isolated virilization.
steps.tx: Distinguish between classic clinical presentations comparing **Classic salt-wasting vs simple virilizing** variants in infancy. Classic CAH is divided into salt-wasting (75%, severe aldosterone deficiency, neonatal shock) and simple virilizing (25%, adequate aldosterone, prenatal virilization in females). Both forms demonstrate progressive adrenal cortical hyperplasia driven by pituitary corticotropin elevation.

left.title: Salt-Wasting CAH (75%)
points: Neonatal shock and severe salt crisis

steps.say: Salt losing neonates deteriorate rapidly with cardiovascular collapse and life threatening electrolyte derangements.
steps.tx: Identify acute metabolic collapse by recognizing **Salt-wasting crisis clinical presentation** during the second week of life. Salt-wasting neonates present at 7-14 days of life with vomiting, weight loss, lethargy, hyponatremia (Na < 125 mEq/L), hyperkalemia (K > 7.0 mEq/L), metabolic acidosis, and hypovolemic shock.

vis.title: Salt-Wasting Neonatal Crisis Parameters
rows: Maternal aldosterone clearance reveals mineralocorticoid deficit
Renal tubular sodium wasting with volume contraction
Failure of principal cell potassium excretion
Severe hypovolemia and impaired vascular tone

steps.say: Universal neonatal dried blood spot screening enables early pre-symptomatic detection of severe steroid enzyme blocks.
steps.tx: Establish biochemical confirmation through neonatal screening using **Newborn 17-OHP screening threshold** limits. Newborn blood spot screening measures 17-hydroxyprogesterone (17-OHP) via immunoassay or tandem mass spectrometry; levels > 30-100 nmol/L confirm classic 21-hydroxylase deficiency. Premature infants require gestation-adjusted birth weight nomograms to minimize false-positive recalls.

vis.title: Newborn Dried Blood Spot 17-OHP Screening
rows: Stratifies false positives in premature neonates

steps.say: Emergency fluid resuscitation corrects hypovolemic shock and hypoglycemia while avoiding cardiotoxic potassium.
steps.tx: Initiate emergency stabilization by infusing **Acute crisis resuscitation fluid** without any added potassium. Immediate resuscitation requires an IV bolus of 0.9% normal saline (20 mL/kg) with 5-10% dextrose to treat hypovolemia and hypoglycemia, followed by parenteral hydrocortisone; potassium-containing fluids are strictly forbidden.

steps.say: Lifelong dual hormone replacement suppresses pituitary drive while maintaining fluid and electrolyte balance.
steps.tx: Prescribe chronic physiologic replacement by titrating **Maintenance hydrocortisone and fludrocortisone dosing** across infancy. Maintenance therapy requires oral hydrocortisone (10-15 mg/m²/day divided TID) and fludrocortisone (0.05-0.2 mg/day) plus oral sodium chloride supplements (1-2 g/day, 17-34 mEq/day) in infants. Plasma renin activity and 17-OHP are monitored periodically.

vis.title: Maintenance Replacement Regimen in CAH
rows: Replaces glucocorticoid and suppresses ACTH drive
Normalizes renin and maintains intravascular volume
Compensates for immature renal tubular sodium conservation

steps.say: Transplacental dexamethasone therapy prevents virilization of female external genitalia when initiated early in pregnancy.
steps.tx: Evaluate controversial maternal intervention assessing **Prenatal dexamethasone ethics and indication** protocols. Maternal dexamethasone (20 mcg/kg/day) initiated before 9 weeks gestation suppresses fetal ACTH and virilization in at-risk female fetuses; requires early non-invasive prenatal sex determination via cell-free fetal DNA. Therapy is promptly discontinued if the fetus is confirmed 46,XY.

steps.say: High circulating trophic drive stimulates benign ectopic nodular hyperplasia within the testes of affected males.
steps.tx: Screen adolescent and adult males with CAH through **Testicular adrenal rest tumors (TART) monitoring** sonography. Males with poorly controlled CAH develop bilateral testicular adrenal rest tumors (TART) stimulated by chronic ACTH elevation, causing testicular discomfort and infertility, detected by routine testicular ultrasound.

nodes.label: Stimulation of Aberrant Adrenal Rest Tissue in Rete Testis
